spindle.name: Human muscle spindle
spindle.read: Human muscle, transverse histology. The specimen has its own scale.

receptors.name: Muscle length and tension receptors
receptors.read: Mouse tissue and a schematic from Oliver and colleagues. This figure locates spindle and tendon organs, distinct from thin group III/IV afferents.

cord.name: Spinal grey matter
cord.read: Adult human lumbar enlargement. Compare dorsal sensory and ventral motor territories in the authors’ lamina maps and stained tissue. Each panel retains the authors’ orientation.
cord.modality: Human · lumbar cord tissue and lamina maps
cord.source: Zhang, Chen, Wei et al. (2024), Fig. 3

corticospinal.name: Descending skeletal motor pathway
corticospinal.read: An anatomical teaching diagram follows the corticospinal tract and motor neuron. The fibres are illustrated, with no registration to the human atlas.

pag.name: Midbrain · around the aqueduct
pag.read: Plate 5, +8.23 mm relative to the pontomesencephalic junction. Find PAG, the periaqueductal gray that surrounds the narrow fluid channel called the cerebral aqueduct.

pbn.name: Upper pons · parabrachial region
pbn.read: Plate F, −5.91 mm relative to the same junction. Find the lateral and medial parabrachial nuclei (LPB and MPB) beside the superior cerebellar peduncle, a bundle of fibres connecting the cerebellum and brainstem. This series uses an additional histochemical stain.

medulla.name: Medulla · solitary and vagal motor nuclei
medulla.read: Plate 37, −35.87 mm relative to the junction. Compare Sol (solitary nucleus), 10N (dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus) and Amb (nucleus ambiguus). Lowercase sol labels the tract.

enteric.name: Nerves in the human colon wall
enteric.read: In panels E–F, examine the nerve networks within human colon tissue. This preparation has its own scale and orientation. The HRA colon surface is a separate reference.

medulla36.name: Medulla · one section rostral
medulla36.read: Plate 36, −34.87 mm. Find Sol and 10N near the fourth ventricle, and Amb farther lateral. Gr and Cu locate dorsal-column relays.

medulla38.name: Medulla · one section caudal
medulla38.read: Plate 38, −36.87 mm. Follow Sol, 10N and Amb across this section; ia identifies internal arcuate fibres.
